title: Desenvolvedor
description:
Desenvolvedor Salesforce Apex e LWC

Contratação PJ

Atuação 100% remota


Projeto de alta complexidade, com forte volume transacional e integrações robustas com Oracle e ERP acadêmico.

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento majoritário em Apex e Lightning Web Components (LWC)

Construção de integrações REST/SOAP

Customizações avançadas e configurações complexas

Experiência sólida em Apex e Lightning Web Components (LWC)

Vivência com integrações complexas

Experiência com alto volume transacional

Conhecimento em arquitetura de integrações


Diferenciais

Experiência com Education Cloud

Vivência em projetos enterprise

A Softtek valoriza a diversidade e inclusão em sua força de trabalho. A empresa tem uma equipe global com pessoas de diferentes origens e culturas, o que torna o ambiente de trabalho mais rico e interessante. Independentemente da sua, etnia, idade, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, credo ou convicção política, o que importa são as suas competências e habilidades para fazer acontecer


Os Softtekians são seres humanos talentosos e autodeterminados que se consideram pessoas loucamente incríveis! Venha fazer parte desse time!!!


Quer saber mais? Acesse:


Sobre a Softtek : Fundada em 1982, a Softtek é uma fornecedora global de soluções de TI orientadas a processos com 30 escritórios na América do Norte, América Latina, Europa e Ásia. Com 15 centros de entrega global nos EUA, México, China, Brasil, Argentina, Costa Rica, Espanha, Hungria e Índia, a Softtek ajuda a melhorar e produzir resultados previsíveis para corporações de primeira linha em mais de 20 países. A Softtek é a criadora e líder da indústria nearshore.


Para obter mais informações sobre o que fazemos, quem somos e oportunidades de carreira, visite

title: Desenvolvedor .Net
description:
We are looking for a seasoned Full Stack or Frontend-focused developer with strong .NET and C# expertise to join a globally distributed team. The ideal candidate bridges legacy system maintenance with modern platform evolution, delivering robust, secure, and scalable solutions in an international insurance environment.


Mandatory Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience (full stack or frontend-focused);
  • Strong command of .NET / C# development;
  • Proven experience maintaining legacy .NET Framework applications alongside modernization work in .NET Core / .NET;
  • Proficiency with React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3;
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs, including API integrations;
  • Hands-on experience with Kendo UI for component-rich frontend development;
  • Experience building cross-platform applications with .NET MAUI;
  • Working knowledge of relational databases (SQL Server preferred).
  • Security & Identity: OAuth 2.0, JWT, and other identity/authentication frameworks;
  • Architecture & Patterns: MVC, MVVM, layered architecture, microservices.


Language Requirements

  • Fluent in English — written and verbal
  • Fluent in Spanish — written and verbal


Nice to Have

  • Microsoft Power Platform : hands-on familiarity with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI;
  • Azure & DevOps: Azure services — web apps, API hosting, and DevOps pipelines and Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks experience;
  • Security & Compliance: Secure coding practices, identity management, and data protection (critical for the international insurance context);
  • Industry Experience: Background in healthcare or insurance industries is a strong plus.


Location : Home Office

PJ Contract - Salary: Negotiable

Start Availability : Immediate

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back End Java PL
description:
Aqui na Zallpy, tecnologia nasce de pessoas curiosas, colaborativas e com vontade de fazer bem feito. Se você gosta de ambientes onde existe espaço para perguntar, testar, aprender e evoluir junto, se liga nessa oportunidade!

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar em um time que pensa grande, trabalha com atenção aos detalhes, parceria no dia a dia e responsabilidade compartilhada. Acreditamos em autonomia, troca entre diferentes experiências e soluções construídas em conjunto.

Por aqui, crescer significa compartilhar conhecimento, respeitar diferentes formas de pensar e construir relações de confiança enquanto entregamos tecnologia de qualidade.

Se você se identifica com esse jeito de trabalhar, vem somar com a gente.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Interpretar e compreender os requisitos do projeto.
  • Colaborar com as partes interessadas para esclarecer especificações.
  • Criar designs técnicos sólidos, considerando escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.
  • Desenvolver e executar testes unitários para garantir a robustez do código.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com membros da equipe, incluindo desenvolvedores, arquitetos e profissionais de QA.
  • Participar de reuniões de planejamento e revisões de código.
  • Atualizar e manter o código conforme necessário para atender a requisitos em evolução.
  • Criar documentação clara e abrangente do código, design e processos.
  • Facilitar a compreensão do sistema para outros membros da equipe.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências tecnológicas relacionadas a Java.


O que estamos buscando:

  • Java versão 8 ou superior;
  • Spring Ecosystem - Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Spring Data, Spring Cloud e Spring Security;
  • Microsserviços;
  • Bancos de Dados SQL e NoSQL;
  • Testes unitários e de integração;
  • Git;
  • Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Mensageria;
  • Conceitos de cloud (AWS/Azure);
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Boas práticas como Clean Code e SOLID;
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Onde você vai trabalhar:

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota.


Modalidades de contratação

  • Cooperado


Benefícios de ser um Zallper:


Wellhub

Acesso a academias, atividades físicas e bem-estar.

title: Desenvolvedor de aplicativos
description:
Procuramos Desenvolvedor React Native – App com IA (produto já desenvolvido)


Estamos evoluindo um aplicativo baseado em IA que já está praticamente pronto e buscamos um desenvolvedor mobile com experiência em React Native para colaborar na próxima fase do projeto.

Stack principal

React Native

 JavaScript / TypeScript

 Integração com APIs REST

 Deploy para iOS e Android

Git

O projeto

O aplicativo já foi desenvolvido e está funcional. O foco agora é evolução do produto, melhorias e novas funcionalidades.

Modelo de participação

Estamos abertos a duas possibilidades:

Cofundador técnico (equity) para quem quer participar da construção e crescimento da startup

Contratação como desenvolvedor para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução do app

 Diferenciais

* Experiência com apps híbridos ou Ionic

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Node Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com foco em Node.js , que tenha forte experiência em construção de APIs, integração entre sistemas e arquitetura de aplicações escaláveis. Essa pessoa terá papel importante tanto no desenvolvimento quanto na definição de boas práticas técnicas junto ao time.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir backends escaláveis , incluindo APIs, scripts, jobs e processos de carga de dados.
  • Atuar na integração entre sistemas , utilizando REST APIs, SOAP e outros formatos de comunicação.
  • Contribuir para a definição de arquitetura e decisões técnicas , apoiando na escolha de tecnologias, frameworks e padrões.
  • Garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais .
  • Colaborar com o time na organização do backlog técnico e evolução da arquitetura das aplicações .
  • Participar da definição de MVPs e evolução progressiva das soluções , equilibrando qualidade técnica e prazos de entrega.
  • Atuar em colaboração com outras áreas e clientes, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas eficientes .


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Node.js .
  • Experiência na construção de APIs e integração entre sistemas (REST, SOAP, troca de arquivos).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Vivência com arquitetura de microsserviços, mensageria e Design Patterns .
  • Experiência com práticas de DevOps , utilizando ferramentas como Docker, Kubernetes, Git e pipelines de CI/CD.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes com arquiteturas distribuídas e sistemas de alta escala .

title: Assistente de processos
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa organizada, analítica e colaborativa para atuar como Assistente de Processos, apoiando iniciativas de melhoria contínua, transformação cultural e organização dos processos internos da instituição.

Essa posição terá papel importante no suporte à implantação de novos modelos de gestão, padronização de processos e acompanhamento de iniciativas que promovam mais eficiência, colaboração entre áreas e clareza na execução das atividades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Apoiar o mapeamento, análise e melhoria de processos internos da instituição.
  • Contribuir com iniciativas de transformação cultural e melhoria da gestão, incluindo organização de ritos de gestão e rotinas de acompanhamento.
  • Auxiliar na padronização e documentação de processos, fluxos e procedimentos.
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento de planos de ação, indicadores e iniciativas de melhoria.
  • Organizar registros, materiais e informações relacionadas às iniciativas de governança e processos.
  • Apoiar a preparação de reuniões, workshops e treinamentos internos voltados à melhoria organizacional.
  • Colaborar com diferentes áreas da instituição, facilitando o fluxo de informações e a organização das demandas.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído em Administração, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas.
  • Interesse por temas relacionados a processos, melhoria contínua, governança e eficiência organizacional.
  • Boa organização, atenção a detalhes e capacidade de estruturar informações.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e interagir com diferentes áreas.

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.




Important Candidate Notice : On January 9, 2026, CommScope finalized the sale of its Connectivity and Cable Solutions segment, which included the CommScope name and brand, to Amphenol Corporation. The remaining businesses — Access Networks Solutions (now rebranded as Aurora Networks ) and RUCKUS Networks have been unified under the new parent company, renamed as Vistance Networks . The role being advertised is part of RUCKUS Networks.


Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.


Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: Elementor Expert (WordPress Website Builder)
description:
We are looking for a skilled WordPress developer with strong Elementor experience to join our team and build high-performance websites for our marketing agency clients.


This role focuses on executing a proven build process , not designing sites from scratch. You’ll work from established Elementor Pro templates while inserting pre-generated content and images created by our internal AI systems.


If you enjoy working within clear systems and take pride in building clean, fast, and polished websites , this role will be a great fit.



Responsibilities


  • Build 3–4 WordPress websites per week using pre-built Elementor Pro templates
  • Insert AI-generated content into website layouts (all content is provided)
  • Adjust layouts and design elements to tailor each template for the client
  • Generate website visuals using AI image tools based on supplied prompts
  • Create simple design assets when needed using Canva
  • Integrate WooCommerce functionality for ecommerce websites
  • Ensure each website achieves extremely fast page load speeds (under 1 second)
  • Follow documented build processes and workflows precisely



Required Skills & Experience


  • Advanced proficiency with Elementor and Elementor Pro
  • Strong knowledge of WordPress performance optimization
  • Experience configuring WooCommerce within Elementor websites
  • Familiarity with AI image generation tools (Midjourney, DALL-E, OpenAI, etc.)
  • Basic graphic design ability and experience with Canva
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Available during EST business hours
  • Highly organized and comfortable working within defined processes



What This Role Focuses On


This role is about efficiently producing high-quality websites using a repeatable system .


You will not be responsible for writing content or designing full websites from scratch. Our automation tools generate the text and provide prompts for images. Your job is to assemble the site using templates, produce visuals, refine the layout, and ensure the final result is clean, professional, and extremely fast.



Important Note


⚡ Performance is critical.

Every site must achieve full page load speeds under 1 second without relying on caching solutions.


If you do not have strong experience optimizing WordPress for speed, this role will not be a good fit.



What We Provide


  • Managed hosting accounts
  • Elementor Pro licenses
  • AI-generated content for every site
  • Image prompts for generating visuals
  • Detailed documentation and build processes
  • A steady pipeline of website projects


Full-time role

Working hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (±1 hour flexibility)



Who We’re Looking For


The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, efficient, and process-driven . You take pride in producing polished work, enjoy following clear systems, and understand how small optimizations can dramatically impact website performance.


You’re comfortable using modern tools like AI image generators, you work quickly without sacrificing quality, and you care about delivering websites that are both visually clean and technically fast .

title: Engenheiro de Dados PL
description:
Se você gosta de desafios e quer mostrar todo o seu potencial, queremos te conhecer! A Vericode preza por um time inclusivo e repleto de diversidade, nas suas mais variadas representações. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência!


#VemSerVericoder

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Construir, evoluir e sustentar pipelines de dados em AWS (S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift), priorizando custos, confiabilidade e observabilidade.
  • Orquestrar cargas incrementais/idempotentes no Apache Airflow (MWAA), com SLAs, retries, backfill e alertas.
  • Desenvolver jobs AWS Glue (PySpark) com tratamento de schema evolution, particionamento, tuning e uso do Glue Data Catalog.
  • Modelar camadas Bronze/Silver/Gold (Medallion) e Dimensional (Star/Snowflake) para consumo analítico.
  • Atuar em SQL Server/SSIS (on‑prem) em migrações/modernizações e integrações com o lake na AWS.
  • Escrever código limpo em Python/PySpark, YAML para DAGs/configs e praticar CI/CD (testes, code review, versionamento).
  • Colaborar com times de produto/negócio, traduzindo requisitos em soluções de dados com métricas e contratos claros.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Hard Skills (Obrigatórias)

  • AWS: S3, Glue (jobs/crawlers/Catalog), EMR (Spark), Redshift, Athena (desejável).
  • Airflow/MWAA: DAGs parametrizadas, sensors/operators AWS, backfill e monitoramento.
  • SQL ANSI: joins, window functions, CTEs, `MERGE`, tuning básico.
  • On‑prem: SQL Server (T‑SQL), SSIS (ETL).
  • Modelagem: Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) e Dimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake).
  • Python e PySpark (RDD/DataFrame API), particionamento e file sizing.
  • YAML para configs de pipelines e CI/CD (GitHub/GitLab, testes e deploy).
  • Kubernetes (básico): conceitos de pod/deployment e operação de workloads de dados (desejável).

Soft Skills (com foco em clientes e resiliência)

  • Comunicação com clientes internos: explicar soluções de dados em linguagem simples e foco em valor.
  • Resiliência operacional: manter a calma e priorizar ações durante incidentes (falhas de pipeline/SLAs).
  • Colaboração e negociação com múltiplos stakeholders (produtos, risco, compliance).
  • Mindset investigativo e resolução de problemas com documentação clara e pós‑mortem objetivo.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Trino.
  • Boas práticas de FinOps e monitoramento (CloudWatch/Prometheus).
  • Noções de segurança/mascaramento em camadas de consumo.

Benefícios:

  • Reembolso de Capacitações Técnicas: Cobertura de 100% para certificações profissionais, além de reembolso para cursos de capacitação técnica;

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Service Cloud Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 58531



Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar funcionalidades em Apex (triggers, services, batch/queueable/schedulable), garantindo bulkification, testes e respeito aos limites da plataforma.
  • Desenvolver Lightning Web Components (LWC) com arquitetura limpa, performance, consumo de dados via LDS/wire e chamadas @AuraEnabled.
  • Construir e manter integrações (REST/SOAP): callouts com Named Credentials, autenticação (OAuth/JWT), tratamento de erros e observabilidade (logs/monitoramento).
  • Atuar no ecossistema de Service Cloud & Digital Engagement (Chat, WhatsApp, Bots), integrando fluxos de atendimento e automações.
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado (debug logs, trace flags, Event Monitoring) e otimizações de performance/consultas.
  • Versionar e implantar com SFDX + Git (branching, code review, qualidade de código).
  • Garantir segurança e compliance (FLS/CRUD, compartilhamento, transações) e produzir documentação técnica de suporte às entregas.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Forte experiência como Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce (Pleno/Sênior) com foco em Service Cloud.
  • Domínio de Apex, SOQL/SOSL, padrões assíncronos e testes unitários (qualidade e cobertura).
  • Experiência com LWC (JS moderno, componentização, comunicação com Apex).
  • Vivência com Digital Engagement (Chat/Messaging/WhatsApp), incluindo implementação técnica e integração com processos de atendimento.
  • Integrações via API REST/SOAP em Apex (Named Credentials, serialização JSON/XML, tratamento de exceções).
  • Troubleshooting e análise de logs em ambientes produtivos e sandboxes.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de governor limits e estratégias de otimização.
  • Prática com Salesforce DX e Git (pull requests, code review).
  • Certificações: Platform Developer I

CLT, salário a combinar+ benefícios.

100% remoto.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Content Analyst
description:
Career Opportunity: Content Analyst at Hartwell Companies


Hartwell Companies, a leader in industry innovation and a hub for top-tier talent, is on the lookout for an experienced Content Analyst to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to make an impact in a dynamic, growth-oriented organization.


About Us: Hartwell Companies bring together strategically aligned businesses with a shared commitment to growth, innovation, and positive impact. We are a collective of dynamic enterprises, providing management experience, fresh insights, and resources to nurture each brand under our umbrella.


Position: Content Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Model: Contractor Remote

Working Hours: 8 AM to 5 PM EST


Job Description:

The primary purpose of this role is to plan, coordinate, and execute the content strategy for Hartwell companies, including SONCO Safety Marketplace.

The Content Analyst will ensure all website content is SEO-driven and aligned with Information Architecture (IA) best practices to improve search rankings, organic traffic, and user experience.

This role includes creating product descriptions for new product pages, developing content for all website pages, social media, producing customer success cases, and building alliances with organizations, associations, and LinkedIn communities to generate co-marketing initiatives.


Main Responsibilities

  • Plan, create, and distribute valuable content.
  • Lead the development and optimization of website product pages, ensuring excellent user experience and strong SEO performance.
  • Ensure website content supports the SEO strategy, including keyword targeting, internal linking, and Information Architecture improvements to enhance rankings and crawlability.
  • Collaborate with design, video, and content writing teams to produce high-quality, SEO-driven content.
  • Plan and write customer success stories and blog posts for our website. Conduct customer interviews to gather accurate information and brief the copywriting team effectively.
  • Define and pursue alliances with organizations, associations, and LinkedIn communities for co-marketing initiatives.
  • Review and refine digital ad content to ensure consistency and performance alignment.
  • Develop attractive, original content to attract and retain users.
  • Distribute content across channels (website, social media, email, blog).
  • Own and optimize the customer review process.
  • Support the marketing team by conducting client surveys.
  • Measure, analyze, and present results of content strategy efforts, including SEO and organic performance metrics.


Skills and Competencies required:

  • Exceptional writing and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Advanced skill level in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with WordPress.
  • Knowledge of web publishing requirements and content structuring best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with SEO and web traffic metrics.
  • Understanding of Information Architecture (IA) principles and how content structure impacts SEO and user experience.
  • Strong familiarity with various social media platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to use own initiative to progress work and to work to deadlines.
  • Flexible and creative attitude toward problem-solving.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across business units.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory, with the ability to write and interact with the US-based team.


Other details of the position:

  • Contract type: Full-time consultant.
  • Working hours: 8 hours daily (from 8 am to 5 pm EST).

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

  • Experiência com versionamento de código com Git;

  • Experiência com Quarkus ou Spring Boot ;

title: Virtual Assistant – Real Estate Operations & Executive Support
description:
Polaris Advisors is a high-performing real estate team at Compass , specializing in residential sales, investments, and advisory services in South Florida. Known for its strategic approach, strong operational structure, and client-focused execution, Polaris Advisors delivers a high-level experience across every stage of the real estate process.


We are seeking a high-performing Virtual Assistant based in Brazil to support our Real Estate Operations and Marketing team at a high-producing team at Compass . This is a remote position for candidates located in Brazil , compensated in Brazilian Reais (BRL) .


This role requires a professional who is highly organized, detail-oriented, tech-savvy , and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven U.S. real estate environment .


You will work closely with the Real Estate Operations Manager and the Principal of the team , supporting property listings, marketing initiatives, and operational workflows. This position is ideal for someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly, and consistently delivers high-quality execution.


Training will be provided on MLS systems and the Compass platform , and the ideal candidate must demonstrate a strong ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools and technologies.


Key Responsibilities


Administrative Operations

• Prepare and manage buyer and seller documentation using the Compass platform

• Organize and maintain internal trackers, digital files, and compliance documentation using Google Drive and Compass systems

• Maintain the listing and transaction pipeline with accurate and up-to-date information

• Coordinate post-closing follow-ups, including testimonial requests


Listing & Deal Coordination

• Coordinate listing preparation, including ordering photography, signage, and related services

• Upload and manage listings across Compass, MLS, Zillow, and related platforms

• Prepare marketing materials, including social media posts, open house flyers, and email blasts

• Ensure full compliance with Compass systems and listing requirements

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Front-end Developer (React.js) - Project
description:
We are looking for a remote, skilled Senior Front-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience in React.js to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping ideas and user feedback into delightful experiences, developing and implementing user interface components into the latest React.js concepts and workflows, and leading the engineering efforts for user-facing features. You will work with our product and user experience teams to deliver end-to-end features that deliver business value that users love.


This project has a 6-month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.


Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform allows companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the User Experience and Product teams to create end-to-end designs for new features
  • Take ownership of product features from design, implementation, and delivery, to post-delivery feedback and follow-up work
  • Coordinate development efforts across team members and ensure successful delivery
  • Architect, develop, and implement highly-responsive user interface components using JavaScript and React.js
  • Provide technical leadership to teammates through coaching and mentorship
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, and help find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience as a front-end engineer writing single-page applications that communicate with API back-ends, and knowledge of JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A well-developed understanding of frontend concepts and various frameworks
  • A focus on delivering value to customers
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentlessness in pursuing goals and solving problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field
  • Node.js and Python experience
  • Additional Information
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays annually
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger


The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Veterinarian
description:
About SignalPET


SignalPET is a fast-growing veterinary AI company working alongside veterinarians and radiologists to deliver faster, more accurate diagnostic support. Our mission is to enhance clinical decision-making through intelligent technology grounded in real-world veterinary medicine.


We are expanding our Medical R&D team in Brazil and are looking for a clinically strong, detail-oriented veterinarian to help build and refine the medical intelligence powering our platform.


The Role


As a Veterinarian – Medical Education & Medical Content , you will transform real SignalPET clinical cases into structured educational modules and high-quality medical marketing content.


You will help build and execute the SignalPET Training Hub & Academy , including CE-accredited learning modules, case-based training, and medical campaigns that strengthen veterinarians’ radiology skills and reinforce SignalPET’s clinical authority.


This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role working closely with:


  • Board-certified radiologists
  • Medical R&D
  • AI and Product teams
  • Marketing


Key Responsibilities


Academy & CE Content Development


  • Develop structured, case-based learning modules using real SignalPET cases
  • Create CE-accredited courses, micro-learning sessions, pathology refreshers, and interactive quizzes
  • Build AI vs. Radiologist comparison educational insights
  • Work with specialists to validate medical accuracy
  • Manage and publish modules inside the Training Hub platform


Medical Marketing Content


  • Write clinically authoritative blogs, case spotlights, white papers, landing page content, and educational campaigns
  • Develop product-related medical materials and sales enablement tools
  • Collaborate with marketing to align messaging and positioning
  • Ensure scientific credibility through specialist validation


Workflow-Connected Learning


  • Map common clinical findings (e.g., splenic masses, thoracic disease, trauma cases) to relevant Academy modules
  • Collaborate with AI and Product teams to connect case workflows with learning opportunities


Performance & Optimization


  • Define and track CE engagement, learning participation, and content performance metrics
  • Continuously refine modules based on user feedback and clinical data


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Participate in relevant internal meetings
  • Provide medical clarification for marketing and product initiatives
  • Coordinate with specialists and Medical R&D for content validation


Requirements


  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) or equivalent
  • Clinical Experience - Hands-on experience in small animal practice
  • Strong radiographic interpretation skills (canine & feline)
  • Radiology-focused experience is a plus
  • Excellent English writing skills (medical & educational content)
  • Ability to translate complex medical topics into clear, structured content
  • Experience creating CE-accredited content is a strong advantage
  • Strong small animal radiology knowledge
  • Ability to collaborate with board-certified specialists
  • Understanding of adult learning principles
  • Comfortable working in CMS and digital platforms


Working Hours


  • Monday to Friday - 7am to 4pm


*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.



Why Join SignalPET?


  • Work at the intersection of veterinary medicine and AI
  • Impact thousands of veterinary professionals globally
  • Remote flexibility
  • Be part of a growing, mission-driven team

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.


Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.

A rotina também inclui o acompanhamento de pedidos, negociações comerciais e esforço contínuo para atingir metas e resultados.

  • Habilidades em vendas: Experiência com técnicas de vendas, negociação e fechamento de negócios de forma eficaz.

  • Comunicação: Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita para articular as características e benefícios dos produtos da empresa.
  • Gestão de tarefas: Capacidade de organização, cumprimento de prazos e gerenciamento eficiente de múltiplas responsabilidades.

title: Full Stack - .NET Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 58724


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera desenvolvedor, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

title: Desenvolvimento .NET AWS Sênior
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com .NET e AWS.


Requisitos e Qualificações:


  • NET Core, AWS;
  • Conceitos de microserviços e aplicações distribuídas;
  • Testes unitários;
  • Conhecimento em REST APIs;
  • Docker, Kubernetes;
  • Desenvolvimento em Cloud AWS;
  • RDS MySQL e DynamoDB, AWS Lambda utilizando Python, ECS Fargate, Elastic Cache Redis, API Gateway, EventBridge, Secrets Manager, KMS, etc;
  • SQL (SQL Server ou MySQL) e DynamoDB;
  • Serviço de Mensageria: KAFTA;
  • Experiência em CI/CD (CodeCommit, CodePipeline, CodeBuild);
  • Conhecimento dos conceitos: Ágil, DevOps e Lean.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java) - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Senior Backend Engineer (Java) position focuses on designing and developing sophisticated, scalable backend systems using Java technologies. This role involves leading technical initiatives, mentoring junior engineers, and creating high-performance, robust solutions that address complex business challenges while implementing microservices architectures and ensuring technical excellence across the team.


Key responsibilities


- Architecting and implementing complex, scalable backend services using Java and related technologies.

- Leading technical design and implementation of enterprise-level software solutions.

- Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to the team's technical excellence and best practices.

- Designing and optimizing database schemas and data access strategies for performance and scalability.

- Implementing microservices architectures and cloud-native applications.

- Conducting comprehensive code reviews and ensuring high-quality, maintainable code across projects.


Requirements


- Backend Development: 4+ years of hands-on experience with Java backend development.

- Java Ecosystem: Strong expertise in Java ecosystem and enterprise application design.

- Architecture Knowledge: Advanced understanding of software architecture and design patterns.

- Modern Frameworks: Experience with Spring Boot, microservices, and cloud platforms.

- Database Expertise: Proficiency in database design and optimization techniques.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Corporate Content Creator
description:
Company Overview:

Lean Tech is a fast-growing technology company based in Medellín, Colombia, with a strong network in software development and IT services across the entertainment, financial, and logistics industries. The company offers significant opportunities for professional growth while working with engineering teams across Latin America and the United States on innovative projects. Lean Tech is seeking a Mid-level Corporate Content Creator & Training Evangelist to design and deliver high-quality multimedia training materials that communicate company initiatives, operational standards, and internal programs. This role combines content creation, instructional design, and corporate communication to transform complex operational and technical topics into clear, engaging materials such as documents, presentations, videos, and visual assets. The position will work closely with Operations, Product, Technology, Compliance, and Business Application teams to identify knowledge gaps and develop scalable training programs that enhance employee performance and operational excellence.


Position title: Mid-level Corporate Content Creator

Location: Remote - LATAM


Key Responsibilities:

Content Creation & Corporate Communication

  • Develop high-quality written content including structured documentation, manuals, process guides, and corporate communications using tools such as Microsoft Word and Visio.
  • Produce professional video content, visual assets, and multimedia training materials that effectively communicate company processes, systems, and initiatives.
  • Create engaging PowerPoint presentations, PDF learning materials, and visual storytelling assets for internal education and corporate messaging.
  • Design and produce multimedia learning content including tutorials, explainer videos, diagrams, infographics, and process walkthroughs.
  • Ensure all content follows corporate communication standards, branding, and messaging consistency.


Training Program Design & Instructional Development

  • Design, develop, and implement training curriculums tailored to employee roles and operational requirements.
  • Build structured learning programs including:
  • Best practices
  • Work instructions
  • Process documentation
  • Continuous improvement initiatives
  • Maintain and facilitate training curriculum, demonstrations, documentation, and certification programs for employees across different operational areas.
  • Develop training programs for New Hire Onboarding and Continuous Development, including defined milestones and certification expectations.
  • Create training frameworks that support different learning styles and modern learning methods (visual, video-based, interactive).


Training Delivery & Evangelization

  • Act as a corporate evangelist for training initiatives, promoting adoption of best practices and operational standards across the company.
  • Facilitate training workshops, demos, and learning sessions for internal teams.
  • Drive adoption of training content and learning initiatives through clear communication and engaging delivery methods.


Training Strategy & Performance Monitoring

  • Define and analyze training effectiveness metrics, measuring performance, adoption, and knowledge retention.
  • Monitor training program outcomes to ensure alignment with company standards, compliance policies, and operational procedures.
  • Continuously improve training content based on data insights, feedback, and operational changes.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Business Application Owners, Operations Leadership, Product, Technology, and Compliance teams to identify training gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Work with stakeholders across regions to ensure training programs reflect operational differences by region, station, carrier, mode of transport, or client requirements.
  • Collaborate with teams to ensure data quality, process improvements, and workflow alignment within training materials.

Process & Content Governance

  • Maintain structured documentation repositories and ensure training materials remain current and aligned with evolving company processes.
  • Support workflow optimization and documentation standardization across departments.
  • Contribute to training roadmaps and long-term learning strategies.

Required Skills & QualificationsProfessional Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in content creation, corporate training, instructional design, or learning and development roles.
  • Proven experience producing multimedia training materials including documentation, presentations, video, and visual content.
  • Experience designing corporate training programs and internal knowledge frameworks.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and global organizations.

Content & Media Creation Skills

  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Visio or similar diagramming tools.
  • Experience creating professional training videos and visual content.
  • Strong understanding of instructional design and modern learning methodologies.
  • Ability to produce structured, well-written documentation with excellent editorial quality.
  • Experience with camtasia or other video and image editing.
  • Experience with Adobe reader or other tools to generate content

Communication Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly.
  • Strong storytelling ability to transform technical information into engaging content.

Analytical & Organizational Skills

  • Strong research and analytical skills to identify training opportunities and learning gaps.
  • Ability to analyze training metrics and continuously improve programs.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple content projects simultaneously.

Collaboration & Work Style

  • Strong collaboration skills across distributed and global teams.
  • Ability to work in ambiguous environments and deliver high-quality results with minimal supervision.
  • Empathy for end users to design intuitive and practical learning experiences.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in corporate training, knowledge management, or learning experience design.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS).
  • Experience in global operations environments such as logistics, transportation, or supply chain.
  • Knowledge of project management frameworks and backlog management tools.

Why you will love Lean Tech:

  • Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology
  • Professional development opportunities with international customers
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels.


Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Software Developer (C# / .NET)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Developer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in C# and .NET to join our U.S. client's engineering team. You will lead, develop, and enhance SaaS products used by thousands of customers. The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.

The ideal candidate has strong experience working with technical onshore, offshore, and nearshore teams along with modern cloud-based platforms, particularly within the AWS, Salesforce, Linode, and Heroku ecosystems, and is comfortable leading and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making.

Our client provides innovative software solutions for automobile retailers, having led the market since 2014. With over 6,000 customers across North America, the company enhances the buying experience with cutting-edge software that eases communication and converts interest into purchases. Backed by private equity, the company's software features span website conversion, sales enablement, service offers management, retention marketing, and communication through the lenses of valuations, payments, inventory merchandising, and video.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex web applications using C# and .NET, ensuring high-quality code standards and architectural best practices
  • Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable software solutions
  • Drive technical decision-making for system architecture, technology stack choices, and development processes while maintaining comprehensive documentation and testing strategies
  • Follow agile software development processes, collaborating with both onshore and offshore teams
  • Contribute to the development of cloud-based software using Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, Salesforce APEX and Lightning, PostgreSQL, AWS, MongoDB,.NET, PHP, RoR, Python, ETL/Data feeds, and Heroku
  • Continuously learn and adopt new technologies to improve product functionality

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5-10+ years of professional software development experience
  • Experience with expertise in C# and .NET
  • Experience in Salesforce Lightning and SLDS, APEX, Batch, External Client Apps (Connected App), Remote setting, Salesforce Revenue Cloud with legacy applications, and NetSuite
  • Experience in Business intelligence QuickSight developers, ETL process, and data extraction
  • Strong proficiency in database design and management (Salesforce Objects and triggers, MongoDB, SQL), RESTful API development, and cloud services integration with experience in CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in leading software product development projects
  • Hands-on experience leading technical teams both onshore, offshore & nearshore
  • Working under limited supervision and developing code for new business features based on functional and technical specs
  • Decomposes features for a sprint team into tasks that can be accomplished within a sprint; Provides work BPLOE for tasks
  • Understands and adheres to the area's software lifecycle process
  • Communicates across and outside of the team to answer questions, resolve issues, and assess impacts on other teams of changes being made in their sprint team
  • Learns and utilizes new technologies as required, serves as an expert technical resource, advisor, and mentor in one or more feature sets or technologies supported by the development team
  • Provides technical mentorship and work task direction to a team of developers; able to fill the Technical Owner role on an agile sprint team, holding people accountable for task delivery
  • Works with product management to groom and select Features for their area to be included in upcoming releases
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Knowledge of authentication systems (OAuth/OICS, OWASP security best practices, including rate limiting and data encryption
  • Familiarity with AWS services, monitoring tools, and DevOps practices, with the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and implement effective solutions
  • Experience with DMS and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Cox/VinSolutions, DealerSocket, DealerAccess), and VIN providers (e.g., DataOne, Polk, VinPower)
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4), Tag Manager (GTM), or Tag Assistant (GTA)
  • Knowledge of SaaS environments and SDLC methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Roadmap Release)
  • Knowledge in Business Intelligence tools, ETL, or reporting

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Software Developer (C# / .NET)
description:

You will lead, develop, and enhance SaaS products used by thousands of customers. The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.
